-name: Revenue Planning Copy Estimate to FC

comment.#cdata-section:
Job that is kicked off by the user in the RVP6 report via the Copy Estimate to Forecast on Demand job in the Workflow project. Simply copies the Estimate from the Revenue Planning cube to the required forecast.
